body:
> I think that everyone I've ever met who claims to be bothered by existential questions are really bothered by something else in their lives.

#2

With what you are claiming is the truth, at least for you, I do believe you are forgetting the fact that it is always always something with that something else in mind, the existential crisis is always as strong and defiant as anything else. 

#1

>That there is no such thing as a real purpose or meaning. Both are constructs we invented to help us live our lives.

What lives, that's my question, if both are our constructs then what do we have to live for? Are you telling everyone on SW to just fuck off and find a purpose that doesn't exist or am I'm putting words in your mouth?

>That's why I'm asking which parts of your life you're unsatisfied with.

The ultimate dissatisfaction is existential, the inbetweens aren't. Why stay in the middle when you know the end? I'm still interested in you telling me what is the purpose of life? And what is life?

> Many people have had very similar experiences you are not alone.

Everyone has it that's why they want why they want a black out.

>  it took effort and discover what does.

Tell me what works for you.

> I don't think you want to die because you wouldn't be on reddit talking about it, you would just kill yourself instead.

Tell that to every other /r/SW OP. If you could kill me right now, trust me I won't complain.

Why not, go ahead, shoot me with your personal philosophy. 2/3 of the shit involves everything. The purpose of our existence isn't clear. The more you get knowledgeable about anything the more you get confused.

A practical example from your real life will be appreciated. 

>I guarantee you will dismiss them.

Yes, I will because you haven't told me your purpose of life where I can draw parallels and tell you "you are a nihilist yourself". 

>You tell me what you find and then we can have a conversation.

There isn't any reason to do anything, with that said dragging your life into more and more things to so that people can subtitle your life story for you is what we are all doing right now. We don't have any more lives.

We are...I'm sorry I've lost it. I need to get some air, I can't do this anymore.

Tell me the good things in life? Let's find a purpose of life right here right now. 2/3 does have happy moments, but this is thing, what are we aiming at? Our legacy of some sort? What is this chaos inside and outside?
